NSCameraUsageDescription: We use the camera only when you photograph an animal. You can also pick a photo from your gallery.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We access photos only when you pick a picture of an animal. We do not read your other photos.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to mark the place faster and to show reports nearby. We only show an approximate area in public.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you turn on nearby reminders, your phone checks in the background whether you are near an area where a lost pet was last seen. Your location never leaves your phone.
